positive_control.verdict: public AHR ChIP fails its positive control: canonical TCDD targets carry no more peaks than random genes, so the ahr_prom outcome above is uninformative about binding and is reported only to show that resolution/liftOver was not the reason

note: Gene-level re-test of the bin-level negative (22b): outcome is an AHR TCDD peak within 2 kb of the human TSS; controls are DMSO peaks, TCF21 peaks and expression stratification in human SMC.
